note: Export side is factually confirmed by a dated customs bill-of-lading entry, not by a website claim: mens leather jackets, HS 42031010, Delhi Air → Moscow, 2024-03-29, B/L AUTOF7C4787195A5, consignee AMIGO LOGISTICS LLC (Vnukovo, Russia). The declared HS 420310 matches the actual recorded export code 42031010 — no correction needed. The company is also an importer of raw material (wet blue sheep skins, HS 41051000, from RAWPEL GMBH, UAE, 2024-07-09, B/L 4393280), which is consistent with a genuine leather-garment manufacturer rather than a pure trader; role likely manufacturer or manufacturer_trader, but that is outside this check. Domestic supply evidence: nothing found — no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract or annual-report split is public for this entity; zaubacorp returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) during this session, so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey free view shows shipment counts only, no values, and no figures were invented. Industry note: the batch lists industry_claimed as 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG), which contradicts both the declared HS 420310 and the actual customs records (leather jackets, leather skins) — the company is in leather apparel, not food; flag for the industry field to be corrected. No rejection grounds: the entity appears in live 2024 customs records, so it is operating.
